name: Scheduler
description: 定时任务：按 cron 到点向会话发送提示词或弹出系统通知，侧栏显示下次运行时间与倒计时。

agentTools.name: cron_create
agentTools.description: Create or update a recurring task of this session: at the cron time the host injects the prompt into this session (optionally also shows a system notification). Same storage as the Scheduler sidebar, at most 50 tasks. Cron is 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday, local time). Returns the task with its next run time.

name.description: Task name shown in the sidebar, max 60 chars

schedule.description: 5-field cron in local time, e.g. '*/10 * * * *' (every 10 minutes), '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 09:00), '30 18 * * *'

prompt.description: Text injected into this session at each run (max 8000 chars); for action=notify it is the notification body

action.description: Default prompt: inject into the session. notify: only show a system notification

notify.description: Also show a system notification when action=prompt

id.description: Update this existing task instead of creating one (id from cron_list)

agentTools.name: cron_list
agentTools.description: List the recurring tasks of this session with their cron description, enabled state, next/last run and last error.

agentTools.name: cron_delete
agentTools.description: Delete one recurring task of this session by id.
